en.title: Beneath the Stillness, Light Beyond the Mirror
en.premise: Consumed by the void left by the loss of his beloved family, a young man begins working on the survey of ancient ruins resting on the ocean floor. There, memories once entrusted to the sea by people of the past breathe quietly in the form of mirror-like crystals. While he finds solace in the reflections of his lost loved ones, the deeper he delves into these memories, the more his own sense of self begins to fade. A quiet tale of rebirth that explores how to live on alongside the things we have lost.

zh.title: 凪之底，镜之彼方的光
zh.premise: 失去挚爱家人的青年在空虚的日常中沉沦，随后参与到一项关于海底古代遗迹的调查工作中。在那里，人们曾经寄托给大海的记忆，化作如镜般的结晶体，静静地呼吸着。他在结晶所映照出的故人身影中找到了救赎，但随着对记忆的触碰愈发深沉，他自身的轮廓也随之被削减。这是一个关于如何与失去之物共存的，静谧的重生故事。
